items.name: team-section

Careers and hiring pages

items.name: hero-section-02
items.title: Showreel wheel hero

Brand sites that lead with their work

items.name: testimonials-section

items.name: image-sphere
items.title: Image sphere
items.description: Your images on a WebGL globe you can hold: fling it, click an image and its group lands in a labelled pile.

useCases: Portfolio and gallery pages
Agency and studio websites
Brand, product or campaign image showcases
Event and launch microsites

items.name: hero-section-03
items.title: Artwork fan hero
items.description: A centred headline over a fanned row of artworks with a hand-drawn hint, a line of copy and two pill actions. A deck opens into the fan on load; hover or tap a card and it comes out and turns over in 3D to show the artist, title, medium and price. 4 cards on phones, 5 on tablets, 7 on desktops.

useCases: Art marketplaces and print shops
Creator, illustrator and designer platforms
Portfolio and gallery sites that lead with the work
Membership launches for creative communities

items.name: hero-section-04
items.title: Curtains hero section
items.description: A full-bleed architectural photograph cut into vertical curtain slices that open around the pointer with physics easing, over a geometric Syne headline, brand navbar, and detached floating CTA.

useCases: Architecture and design studio home pages
Creative agency and portfolio landing pages
Editorial launch pages leading with photos
Luxury architecture and spatial design sites

items.name: footer-section
items.title: App download footer
items.description: A dark rounded footer for app sites: a red download panel with App Store and Google Play badges and a diagram of the app as a hub with four feature nodes, light running the wires into it, then four link columns, a pinned post, the copyright and social links. Stays dark in light and dark mode.

useCases: Mobile app and music streaming websites
SaaS sites that end with an app download call
Product landing pages with store badges
Startup sites that need a full footer with socials

items.name: statement-section
items.title: Parted statement
items.description: A big statement parts round a growing image as you scroll, then a second statement rises out of the photo.

useCases: Brand stories and manifesto sections
Agency, studio and fashion websites
Launch pages that need a cinematic moment

items.name: feature-sphere-section
items.title: Feature index sphere

Product feature overviews with imagery
Editorial and portfolio websites

items.name: feature-section-02
items.title: Developer tool features
items.description: A big headline over three cards, each with a detailed drawing of its claim: a DevTools page-weight treemap, a code editor with its deployment on top and one visitor's journey, step by step. Follows your light and dark theme.

useCases: SaaS and analytics product landing pages
Developer tool feature overviews
Product pages that explain an approach in three points

items.name: feature-section-03
items.title: Isometric feature grid
items.description: A big headline and lead beside a 2 × 2 grid of features, each with a detailed isometric drawing on a warm paper tile, framed by crop marks.

Fulfillment, shipping and Shopify app websites
Product pages with illustrated feature grids

items.name: feature-section-04
items.title: Security features with device
items.description: A headline beside a phone on a blurred landscape and a masonry of five feature tiles, each with a tinted, engraved icon plate.

useCases: Crypto wallet and fintech app websites
Security and privacy feature pages
Mobile app landing pages with a device mockup

items.name: arc-carousel
items.title: Arc carousel
items.description: Project names turn on a curved dial beside a linked image: it steps on a spring, drags and flicks by hand with detents, and opens the project in the centre.

useCases: Architecture and design studio websites
Portfolio and selected work pages
Collection and campaign showcases

items.name: word-wheel
items.title: Word wheel
items.description: A centred headline on a picker wheel: words roll through the line to complete “Built for founders”, faded neighbours above and below, in your text size and colour.

Products sold to several kinds of customers
Enterprise sites with a page per industry
Agency and studio home pages

items.name: mosaic-card
items.title: Mosaic card
items.description: A photo with a short line over it: tap and the photo breaks into a mosaic of tiles that dissolves into the next one, while the words rise in one by one.

useCases: About and brand story pages
Company values and culture pages
Careers pages that show what a team believes
Agency and studio manifestos

items.name: swap-grid
items.title: Swap grid
items.description: A row of tall photo cards: tap one and it grows into a pane with its story and a link while the others shrink into a rail, and picking another swaps the two mid-flight.

Studio and agency project indexes
Team, speaker and cast pages with a bio for each person
Menus, rooms or destinations with a story behind each one

items.name: agent-run
items.title: Agent run
items.description: An AI agent's run in one line: a dot-matrix orb, a verb that rolls to each tool it calls, the live call streaming underneath, then a summary that opens to every step.

useCases: AI chat apps showing an agent's work inline
Research, sales and support agents running tools
Copilots built on function calling or MCP
Landing pages for AI agent products

items.name: mrr-movements
items.title: MRR movements
items.description: Recurring revenue month by month as two running totals, gained climbing and lost falling with a dotted net between, a lane per plan, and every customer's upgrade or cancellation shown as a diff.

Founder and investor updates on monthly recurring revenue
Subscription analytics on Stripe or Paddle events
Admin panels that explain why revenue moved this month

items.name: voice-orb
items.title: Voice orb
items.description: A voice assistant's presence as a ball of points: rim lit, it stirs as you talk, dims to think, pulses with speech and wobbles to music, with a talk button and a live mic option.

useCases: Voice assistants and AI voice chat screens
Voice mode in AI chat apps
Call, dictation and voice note recorders
Landing pages for voice AI products

items.name: voice-membrane
items.title: Voice membrane
items.description: A voice assistant as a skin of points on springs, coloured like a soap film: each syllable sends a ripple across it, thinking rolls even rings down from the top, music sets up standing waves.

useCases: Voice assistants and AI voice chat screens
Voice mode in AI chat apps
Music and audio companions that react to sound
Landing pages for voice AI products

items.name: bloom-menu
items.title: Bloom menu
items.description: An account menu that grows out of your avatar: tap it and the avatar blooms into a card with your name, email and grouped links, then folds back into the avatar.

useCases: Account menus in SaaS and dashboard headers
Profile menus in community and creator apps
Workspace switchers and settings shortcuts
Admin panels and internal tools

items.name: testimonials-section-02
items.title: Testimonials carousel
items.description: A clean testimonials slider with square monochrome cards, author avatars, and previous/next carousel controls.

useCases: SaaS and B2B product landing pages
Developer tool and software showcase sites
Customer proof and wall-of-love pages

items.name: testimonials-section-03
items.title: Editorial testimonial section
items.description: A split-pane testimonial section with customer portrait, vertical divider, editorial quote typography, and circular previous/next navigation.

useCases: High-impact SaaS landing pages
Executive and enterprise software websites
Founders and product leadership case studies

items.name: gallery-section
items.title: Dock gallery
items.description: A headline over a drifting rail of photos that swell like a dock under the pointer and open large on click, with a cursor that becomes a View and Close disc.

useCases: Furniture, product and lifestyle brand websites
Campaign and lookbook pages
Studio and portfolio home pages

items.name: editorial-section
items.title: Press stack
items.description: Newspaper and magazine features about your company that slide and stack as the page scrolls, and open on click into more of the article and a link to it.

useCases: Press and media pages
'As featured in' strips on company and about pages
Studios, agencies and brands with magazine coverage

items.name: two-step-sign-in
items.title: Two-step sign-in
items.description: In isometric ink: a sign-in screen floating over a construction grid asks for a code, the phone hops as the text lands, the code pops off as a lit chip and is tossed into the input, the screen takes the hit, and the user is in. Objects move as solids; leans with the pointer; in your theme.

useCases: Auth and identity product sites
SaaS security and login feature sections
Developer tools explaining two-factor sign-in
Onboarding and account security pages

items.name: push-to-deploy
items.title: Push to deploy
items.description: In isometric ink: git push on a terminal tile that presses in on enter sends a pulse down a cable to the dashboard floating behind it, which takes the hit as the deployment slides in, builds and goes live. Objects move as solids; leans with the pointer; in your theme.

useCases: Hosting and deployment platform sites
Developer tools explaining git-based workflows
CI/CD and preview environment feature sections
Developer onboarding and docs landing pages

items.name: gradual-rollout
items.title: Gradual rollout
items.description: In isometric ink: a feature flag's console moves a new version from 10% to 100% of traffic; the new server hops and lights up as its share jumps, the router presses, the old server sinks, and packets on light rails shift across. Objects move as solids; leans with the pointer; in your theme.

useCases: Feature flag and experimentation product sites
Edge and hosting platforms explaining safe releases
Canary and progressive delivery feature sections
Developer tools landing pages about shipping safely

items.name: wallet-coins
items.title: Wallet, card and currencies
items.description: In isometric ink: a thin stitched wallet in a pastel of your brand, the brand card sliding out of its slit, and three currency coins ($ € £) following it out with an overshoot, fanning into an arc and swinging upright while the wallet dips, then idling on a sine wave. A hero object for fintech and banking sites; leans with the pointer; in your theme.

useCases: Fintech and neobank hero sections
Wallet, savings and payments feature sections
Pricing and onboarding pages for banking apps
Empty states for balances and transactions

items.name: bank-deposit
items.title: Bank deposit
items.description: In isometric ink: a small bank in a pastel of your brand, five coins on the ground beside it that leap into the door one by one on an arc, and a balance card on the left whose dollar figure counts up with every credit. A hero object for banking, savings and fintech sites; leans with the pointer; in your theme.

useCases: Banking and savings product heroes
Deposits, top-ups and round-ups feature sections
Fintech onboarding pages about funding an account
Empty states for balances and transactions

items.name: workflow-trigger
items.title: Workflow trigger
items.description: In soft isometric: a mail app, a chat app and an AI step float as rounded tiles, joined by dashed floor lanes with a rounded bend. An event lands in one app, brand ink fills the lane to the AI step and on to the other app, which shows what the workflow did; events take turns, so the flow runs both ways. Leans with the pointer; in your theme.

useCases: Workflow automation and integration platform sites
AI agent and assistant feature sections
Explaining triggers, actions and app integrations
No-code and ops tooling landing pages

items.name: task-status
items.title: Task status
items.description: In soft isometric: a white hub tile and four pastel status tiles (Not started, In progress, Pending, Done) joined by dashed floor routes with a rounded bend. Each task pops up as an issue badge, turns into a light that runs its route with a trailing line and races round its tile's border, and the status glyph answers. No shadow, no glow; leans with the pointer; in your theme.

useCases: Project and task management product sites
Kanban, status and workflow-stage feature sections
Issue tracker and team productivity landing pages
Explaining how work is organized by status

items.name: file-cabinet
items.title: File cabinet
items.description: A complete empty state in isometric ink: a two-drawer file cabinet whose drawer rolls out on its slides, hits its stop and shows there is nothing inside, over a heading, a line of copy and a button you set through props ("No data yet" by default). Real parts, one even outline, no shadow; the open drawer's label carries your brand. Click to replay; leans with the pointer; in your theme.

useCases: Empty states for tables and dashboards with no records
First-run and onboarding screens in SaaS apps
No files, no documents and empty archive screens
CRM, admin and data products needing a placeholder

items.name: open-envelope
items.title: Open envelope
items.description: A complete "your mail is full" state in isometric ink, facing the screen: an open envelope so stuffed that a document is pushed out of its pocket, a second sheet behind it, and an alert badge that pops at its corner, over a heading, a line of copy and two buttons you set through props. One even outline, no shadow; the badge carries your brand. Click to replay; leans with the pointer; in your theme.

useCases: Inbox full and storage limit screens in mail apps
Quota reached and upgrade prompts in SaaS products
File storage and attachment limit warnings
Empty and overflow states for messaging tools

items.name: id-badge
items.title: ID badge
items.description: A complete "no members yet" empty state in isometric ink, facing the screen: a blank ID badge hanging straight from its strap, flicked once so it swings and twists to rest, with a placeholder photo and a plus on its corner, over a heading, a line of copy and a button you set through props. One even outline, no shadow; the plus carries your brand. Click to flick it again; leans with the pointer; in your theme.

useCases: Empty team, members and workspace screens
Invite your first teammate onboarding steps
User management and access control dashboards
HR, directory and community products with no people yet

items.name: prompt-composer
items.title: Prompt composer
items.description: An AI prompt composer: a capsule with Enter to send and voice input, a quick-prompts tray that unfolds above it, and a footer row for attachments, permission mode, model, reasoning depth and usage limits.

useCases: AI assistant and copilot chat inputs
CRM and sales dashboard prompts
Agent consoles and internal tools
Any app where people write prompts to a model
